mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 73 degrees with a dense drizzle near Badger Prairie County Park under a waning crescent moon. Expect the temperature to dip to an overnight low of 69 degrees, with rain expected before morning.

The Verona Fire Department invites you to an open house on September 19 from 10 AM until 2 PM at 101 Lincoln Street. It is a great chance to tour the station, meet your local firefighters, and participate in fire safety activities with the whole family.

You have plenty of local options to choose from. Trivia is available today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to more trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory, live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and the Downtown Farmer's Market.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they arrested a 34-year-old Madison resident for a sexual assault of a child by a school staff member, stemming from an incident that occurred in 2019.
Culver's is closed for the night. We hope you enjoyed the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie today. Be sure to stop by tomorrow starting at 10 AM to try the Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
